operators.name: cos_forward
semantics: Elementwise cosine of input tensor, matching torch.cos(input).
Input and output are CUDA float32 tensors with the same shape.
The operation preserves memory layout and stride information.
Apply elementwise cosine to the input tensor x.
The result has the same shape and dtype as the input.
Pass the tensor through nn.Identity, which returns the tensor unchanged.
No computation is performed; the output is the same tensor object.
